Let's search Wikipedia directly using `wikipedia_search` or curl/fetch via Python script using `run_command` to query Wikipedia API / HTML for Moon perigee and Eliud Kipchoge marathon record.
```python
cmd_out = await run_command('python -c "import urllib.request, json; data = urllib.request.urlopen(\'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&titles=Moon&rvprop=content&rvslots=main&format=json\').read().decode(); print([line for line in data.split(\'\\\\n\') if \'perigee\' in line.lower() or \'kipchoge\' in line.lower()][:10])"')
print(cmd_out[:1000])
```
